caseName: Bowden v. City of San Francisco

summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Northern District of California.
attorneys: Mr. E. B. Holladay and Mr. S. W. Holladay for appellants., Mr. W. I. Brdbeck and Mr. Percy V. Long for appellees.

opinions.text:

Decree affirmed with costs. Hoadly v. San Francisco, 124 U. S. 639, 645; S. C., 94 U. S. 4; S C., 50 California, 265, 273; S. C., 70 California, 320; Townsend v. Greeley, 5 Wall. 326; Grisar v.
